requirements.location: Complete original task and six-section outline, including analysis-unit order and exhibits.
requirements.basis: The outline answers the requested choice among stronger models, sampling, verification, search and simpler execution rather than treating extra thinking as intrinsically useful. It separates fixed-model inference from training/model/verifier changes; covers independent sampling, voting, candidate selection, sequential correction, state search, process/outcome feedback and tool loops. Math, executable code and multi-step interactive tasks have distinct analysis sections. The budget plan includes rejected branches, verifier and tool/retry costs and separates total work, critical path and concurrency. Versioned frozen sources, assumptions, saturation/correlated errors, uncertain feedback and a task-dependent decision tree are explicit. The alternate-language author has only the twenty-source frozen folder and its task, without the English answer. No requirement is missing at outline stage; substantive comparisons and factual reading are ongoing.
